messages:
maria: quick async standup — GPU fleet capacity/prep check
- Yesterday: validated us-east1 spot fallback logic, ran prewarm tests for redwood-7b
- Blockers: seeing ~12% lower usable headroom in europe-west1 due to quota surprise; need quota bump or re-routing
- Today: coordinate prewarm for canary, get CR reviewed for autoscaler tweak

devon: +1 on the eu headroom hit. I dug in — two large reserved leases from partner-project still active (leaked). Filed internal reclaim to infra-ops. We can temporarily route extra traffic to ap-south1 for non-critical workloads.

aj: can take the CR review this afternoon. Ping me with PR link. I also queued a prewarm run for redwood-14b in europe-west1 (8 GPUs) — logs show healthy warmup but KV cache priming is slow. Command I ran:
```
rctl prewarm --model redwood-14b --count 8 --region europe-west1 --type kv-priming
```

sasha: noticed one node in europe-west1 keeps draining every ~3h, suspect oom on runtime. I've added extra logging and an alert rule. cc @maria

infra-bot: Deploy monitor: prewarm-job-1751 completed (eu-west1, 8 GPUs): success, avg latency 48ms :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks all. Action items:
- @devon follow up on partner lease reclaim and ETA
- @aj review CR #4187 for autoscaler batch size before 1700 UTC
- @sasha keep the node drain alert and link logs
- I'll open a support ticket with cloud provider for quota bump and link here (#SUP-9321)

devon: FYI routing change ready, I'll flip a canary for non-critical traffic to ap-south1 at 1630 UTC, will monitor tail-latency :eyes:

aj: CR link: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/4187 — left one comment about backoff setting

maria: perfect. if anyone sees spike, @here call. otherwise we'll reconvene tomorrow. :thumbsup:
